title: Best part of our visit to Barcelona
text: This was my first city bike tour ever.   Especially for Barcelona and especially with Alvaro, it’s the best way to explore and understand the city.  Everything about working with Alvaro was easy.  He met us at our hotel, had the bikes ready, took us on a tour that (safely) covered the whole city.  He’s a fun and engaging guy and even served as our photographer sending us tons of great pics.   This tour was 100% the highlight of our trip.
author: Liam_M
